Messages.Author: Xian
Messages.Body:
This came up in a game the other day, I think I got it right, but
thought I'd double-check. Nothing came up in a couple of quick google
searchs, so I apologize if my google-fu is weak.

Player A bleeds with card 1. Player B cancels card 1 with DoAF. I
then suggested that it was okay for Player A to bleed cardlessly (or
with another card), as the wording on DoAF is similar to the wording on
Red Herring. "...cannot attempt the same action again this turn."
Rather than, say, cannot attempt the same TYPE of action this turn or
something. Or an option to continue unless a bleed or political
action. Etc.

Was this correct, or is there something I missed?

Denial of Aphrodite's Favor
Cardtype: Combat/Reaction
Discipline: Dominate & Fortitude
[dom][for] <Cancel> an action card a younger vampire plays that
requires Presence [pre] as it is played. That card has no effect. {No
cost is paid.} Untap the acting vampire; that vampire cannot attempt
the same action again this turn.
[DOM][FOR] <Cancel> an action modifier or combat card a younger vampire
plays that requires Presence [pre] as it is played. That card has no
effect. {No cost is paid.}

Xian
demystified

Messages.Author: quetzalcoatl
Messages.Body:
You seem to be correct. The wording on Red Herring and Denial match in
the "...cannot attempt the same action again this turn..."

The only difference here is that Red Herring enforces this rule on all
vampires, whereas Denial enforces it only on a single vampire.

David

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Xian wrote:
> This came up in a game the other day, I think I got it right, but
> thought I'd double-check. Nothing came up in a couple of quick google
> searchs, so I apologize if my google-fu is weak.
>

> Player A bleeds with card 1. Player B cancels card 1 with [Denial of Aphrodite's Favor]. I

> then suggested that it was okay for Player A to bleed cardlessly (or
> with another card), as the wording on DoAF is similar to the wording on
> Red Herring. "...cannot attempt the same action again this turn."
> Rather than, say, cannot attempt the same TYPE of action this turn or
> something. Or an option to continue unless a bleed or political
> action. Etc.
>
> Was this correct, or is there something I missed?

Correct. The prohibition against bleeding twice doesn't come to bear,
since the minion didn't bleed at all with card 1.

And card text only prohibits "same action", as you say.
